_doc: Remand Program directives (our take on 7 Days challenges). Chapters open in order; only the open chapter's directives advance. event: fell_tree, craft, place_log, build, loot, kill, enter_poi, clear_poi, survive_hum, read_note, level, sleep, supply_drop, disarm_trap (armed traps taken apart). targets: ids that count (empty = any). min_tier (kill): normal/seeded/bloomed. count: times (for level: the level). reward: xp + items.

defs.name: Fell three trees
defs.description: Timber is shelter, fire and walls. Swing at the trunk, then step clear of where it falls.

defs.name: Make a stone axe
defs.description: A stone, a stick and cordage on the work slate. It bites deeper than your hatchet arm.

defs.name: Build a campfire
defs.description: Lay the campfire from the field manual and feed it. Warmth, cooking, light — and a beacon.

defs.name: Raise a lean-to
defs.description: A roof is a place to sleep, save and come back to.

defs.name: Sleep under your roof
defs.description: Rest in your shelter. The Program logs your position while you sleep.

defs.name: Search ten containers
defs.description: Cupboards, glove boxes, cash registers. People left in a hurry.

defs.name: Go inside a building
defs.description: Listen at the door first. Sleepers don't stay asleep.

defs.name: Put down ten Hollowed
defs.description: Head first. A Hollow without legs still crawls.

defs.name: Read two notes
defs.description: Someone always writes it down. Find out what happened here.

defs.name: Clear a building
defs.description: Every sleeper inside put down. The Program pays for cleared ground.

defs.name: Disarm two traps
defs.description: A wire across a doorway, jaws under the leaves, an alarm on a door. Crouch, look, and take it apart.

defs.name: Set twenty logs
defs.description: Walls that notch together hold. Walls that don't, fall on you.

defs.name: Survive a Hum
defs.description: When the ground hums, they come from every side. Be behind something by then.

defs.name: Recover a supply drop
defs.description: Follow the red smoke. So will they.

defs.name: Reach level 7
defs.description: Spend what you learn — the field manual's Record.

defs.name: Clear a hard building
defs.description: The ranger station, the grange hall, the Timberline or the Okafor place. Whatever is held there is waiting for you.

defs.name: Put down a Seeded or Bloomed Hollowed
defs.description: Pale threads under the skin. They hit harder and take longer to drop.

defs.name: Put down a Blister, Husk or Rammer
defs.description: Keep your distance from the swollen ones, aim for the soft spots on the plated ones, and never stand between a Rammer and a wall.

defs.name: Survive three more Hums
defs.description: They remember what worked against them. So should you.

defs.name: Reach level 12
defs.description: Still here. The Program notes it.

defs.name: Clear the sawmill
defs.description: Larch Hollow's mill, saw floor to sawdust cellar. The Program wants the payroll office opened.
